resources.string: Open a PDF and write directly on its pages. Save a copy with your handwriting included.
You can also open a PDF in Asterinked from Files, email or your browser.
Pen writes · Swipe to turn pages · Double-tap to zoom · Tap with two fingers to undo, three to redo
Finger or pen writes · Two fingers pan and zoom · Tap with two fingers to undo, three to redo
Fingers move the page. To write with a finger, turn on the hand button.
Drag across strokes to erase them
Drag across text to highlight it
This PDF has notes you haven’t exported. Opening another PDF replaces the current draft.
This PDF is already open. Your notes are still here.
No document picker is available on this device.
No PDF viewer is available on this device.
Your latest notes couldn’t be stored on this device. Save a PDF copy now.
Couldn’t read this file. The app that provides it may not allow access. Try downloading it first.
This file isn’t a PDF, or it is damaged.
This PDF is protected by a password. Asterinked can’t open password-protected PDFs yet.
The author of this PDF doesn’t allow changes, so Asterinked can’t add notes to it.
Your last document couldn’t be restored. Open the PDF again to continue.
Couldn’t store this document on your device. Check that storage is available.
Couldn’t create the annotated copy. Your notes are safe.
Couldn’t save to that location. Your notes are safe. Try saving somewhere else.
Your device is out of storage. Free up some space and try again.
This PDF is too large to handle on this device.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
